svg.title: Strangler Fig
svg.desc: Strangler Fig. Put a facade in front of the legacy system and move routes to new services one at a time. Step 1, Add a facade: Put a routing facade in front of the monolith. At first, every route still goes to legacy. Step 2, Extract /catalog: Rebuild /catalog as a new service and flip its route. The old catalog module goes dark. Step 3, Peel off more: Keep peeling: /orders and /users move over one at a time. Rolling back is just a route flip. Step 4, Retire the monolith: The last route moves. With no traffic left, the monolith is decommissioned.

g.text: Put a routing facade in front of the monolith. At first, every route still goes to legacy.
Rebuild /catalog as a new service and flip its route. The old catalog module goes dark.
Keep peeling: /orders and /users move over one at a time. Rolling back is just a route flip.
The last route moves. With no traffic left, the monolith is decommissioned.
